Gojo vs AltTab: Mac window switching or a notch workspace?

AltTab is a dedicated macOS window switcher. Gojo is not a window switcher replacement; it is a notch workspace for controls that surround window-heavy work.

Updated July 6, 20266 min readAll posts

Short answer

Choose AltTab if your main friction is switching among individual windows and you value dedicated switcher controls, previews, filters, and shortcuts. Choose Gojo if you want quick notch access to media, clipboard history, files, calendar and reminders, battery, webcam mirror, Night Shift, and window snapping.

  • Best specialist fit: switching among individual windows with previews, filters, and shortcuts.
  • Best Gojo fit: surrounding window-heavy work with notch controls for media, clipboard, files, and snapping.
  • Use both if AltTab is your switcher and Gojo is your glanceable utility surface.

Where each app fits

Where AltTab is stronger

AltTab is stronger when the problem is moving between many windows. Its feature set centers on thumbnails, filters, configurable shortcuts, gestures, and window controls.

Where Gojo is stronger

Gojo is stronger when the interruption is not just switching windows. It gives the notch a compact set of media, clipboard, file, calendar, battery, webcam, display, and snapping controls.

When to use both

Use AltTab to move among many windows and Gojo for the controls you keep reaching for once you are in the right window.

Permissions and trust notes

Comparison pages are only useful if they are honest about scope. Gojo is a MacBook notch utility, not a blanket replacement for every specialist app. Before granting macOS Accessibility, Automation, Camera, Calendar, or other permissions to any utility, check whether the requested access matches the feature you plan to use.

Official sources checked for this page on July 6, 2026: AltTab official site, AltTab features, AltTab GitHub

  • AltTab is positioned as a macOS window switcher with window previews.
  • AltTab documents configurable shortcuts, filters, gestures, and window controls.
  • Its paid Pro tier adds search, styles, auto-sizing, and more shortcuts.

Comparison method: recommendations are based on primary workflow, permission fit, official source claims, and whether Gojo should complement or replace the specialist app.

FAQ

Is Gojo a replacement for AltTab?

Not as a direct window-switcher replacement. AltTab is specifically for viewing and switching windows; Gojo is a broader notch utility with different daily-use tools.

What does AltTab do on macOS?

AltTab provides a dedicated window switcher. Its official site lists thumbnail previews, configurable shortcuts, filters, gestures, and window controls.

Should I use Gojo or AltTab if I keep many windows open?

Choose AltTab when fast per-window navigation is the primary need. Choose Gojo when quick access to several system and productivity utilities matters more.

Can Gojo and AltTab run together?

Yes. AltTab handles window switching while Gojo handles a notch-based workspace, so the roles are distinct.
